notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an edge case bug with Thelsea the Succubus 
[*] Fixed an issue where if Aurora dies before you arrive in Snapping Bay you start on the wrong level
[/list]

[b]OTHER CHANGE[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor text change in one of the endings 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2 - More Balances
notes.content:
[b]BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Added logic for maximum number of powerups a Player can have in a new game to 10 (this is for the Health, Melee and Ranged powerups; Bag of Holding and Throwing speed are still one-off powerups)
[/list]

[b]LEVEL UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered Aurora damage over time values in certain levels
[*]Added more Aurora health pickups in certain levels
[*]Added a Throwing Speed powerup in the "Road to Pip 1" level (NOTE: if you already picked this powerup up in "Infested Dungeon", you will not be able to pick it up again)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1 - Bug Fixes, Balances, Level and Enemy Updates
notes.content:
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some instant death colliders not triggering
[*] Slowed down dash refresh rate
[/list]

[b]BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowered the amount of ammo gained from collectibles (reguar ammo only) from 15 to 6
[*] Lowered base damage from Regular and DoT projectiles from 5 to 2
[*] Lowered damage of AoE from 10 to 5
[*] Lowered bonus damage multiplier for ranged projectiles from 5 to 3 (Regular, DoT, AoE)
[*] Increased bonus duration multiplier for Paralitic projectile from 1 to 2
[*] Lowered Melee bonus damage multiplier from 10 to 7
[*] Lowered Aurora healing pickups value from 75 to 40
[/list]

[b]LEVEL UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added effects to destructible walls, so they're a bit easier to notice
[*] Fixed sfx issue with the Reaper
[*] Removed spikes from the Reaper area
[*] Added some dialogue to the Reaper
[*] Modified the Gall Spawn Boss room so it includes more attack/spawn points
[/list]

[b]ENEMY UPDATES[/b]
[list]
[*] Modified the Gall Spawn Boss health so it scales with Player boosts
[*] Modified the Gall Spawn damage receiving logic to take less damage from DoT attacks
[*] Modified the Last Warewolf Mini-boss health so it scales with Player boosts
[*] Removed logic on the Last Warewolf Mini-boss to stop movement/attacks on damage receival
[*] Modified the Deathless Devil Mini-boss health so it scales with Player boosts
[*] Modified the Hartstopper Mini-boss health so it scales with Player boosts
[*] Increased the Hartstopper Minion health to 100
[*] Increased the Hartstopper Minion spawn rate
[/list]
